decisions.reason: The renamed 518 FLEX builds on the established BASIC 518, which the firm says has already won many friends, so its results meet the aspiration and give no cause for problemistic search.
The flail shredder line has a page of its own and fits the core mobile-processing portfolio, so one year of uncertain results can be carried by the slack of an established firm.
The mobile grinder line is only mentioned and overlaps with the green-waste grinder, which creates some pressure to consolidate, but it is too early to judge it against the aspiration.

The stationary electric fine shredder gets little visibility, but it supports the firm's stated push into stationary plants and resource-saving solutions, so management keeps it while results remain uncertain.
Green waste and composting are core customer segments, so the firm keeps this grinder line despite its low visibility and lets the market results develop.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line is featured on a page of its own and serves the stationary plant business, so there is no shortfall yet that would justify releasing its resources.
